title: Neuron Soup
subtitle: Field notes on AI systems, platform engineering, interpretability, safety, and the occasional philosophical detour.

posts.title: The Loop Doesn't Need You Anymore
posts.description: We rebuilt our engineering workflow from the ground up. Throughput rose, our comms came back, and we stopped spending all day babysitting our agents.

posts.title: Your Model is Wrong
posts.description: Why does AI’s confident wrongness feel so offensive? Its model of the world is wrong, but so is our model of it. I think we need to build a new Theory of Mind for AI.
